entries.0be427232bae2072: A category corresponding to 'business segments not included in reportable segments,' engaged in real estate leasing, plant construction, civil engineering, building construction, administrative management services, technology development support services and other operations. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,742 million (¥3,614 million in the previous year); as it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last in the listing. The notes state that this mainly includes intra-group transactions.
entries.1065b2ab151befb8: A business that manufactures and sells high-purity metal materials, compound semiconductor wafers, LEDs, conductive materials, battery materials, magnetic materials, reduced iron powder and other products. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥96,137 million (¥158,382 million in the previous year). Major related companies include DOWA Electronics Materials Co., Ltd., DOWA High-Tech Co., Ltd. (conductive and battery materials) and DOWA Semiconductor Akita Co., Ltd., among others.
entries.29765db625a97862: Heat Treatment and Surface Treatment of Metal Materials
entries.5f5666f72eff5c3d: A business engaged in heat treatment and surface treatment of metal materials such as automotive parts, and in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of heat treatment equipment and its ancillary equipment. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,997 million (¥33,763 million in the previous year). Major related companies include DOWA Thermotech Co., Ltd. and DOWA Thermo Engineering Co., Ltd., among others.
entries.80b0914e75609a4a: A business that manufactures and sells copper, brass and copper alloy strip, brass rod, circuit boards and other products, and provides services such as plating. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥147,258 million (¥128,717 million in the previous year). Major related companies include DOWA Metaltech Co., Ltd., DOWA Metal Co., Ltd., DOWA Metanix Co., Ltd. and DOWA Power Device Co., Ltd., among others.
entries.96af18344dbb0bc4: A business that manufactures and sells gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, zinc alloys, indium, platinum, palladium, rhodium, tin, antimony, sulfuric acid and other products, and is the reportable segment with the largest revenue in the group. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥352,169 million (¥254,096 million in the previous year). A major customer whose revenue exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue is Tanaka Kikinzoku Kogyo K.K. (¥159,888 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, mainly from the smelting business).
entries.9f645f83401d3ceb: Manufacture, Sale and Maintenance of Ancillary Equipment
entries.af026a570479ec9c: A business engaged in waste treatment, soil remediation, resource recycling, logistics and other operations. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥111,105 million (¥100,098 million in the previous year). Major related companies are DOWA Eco-System Co., Ltd. and companies in Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Myanmar and China.
entries.d8fa0be57194156b: A non-ferrous metals corporate group centered on metal smelting, with businesses in waste treatment and recycling, electronic materials, metal processing and heat treatment.
